topic: 1.8 million species: why every organism needs one name
title: Why Every Organism Needs One Name
summary: Aam, mango, maamidi: one fruit, many names, and one word robin for two different birds. With about 1.8 million species, science needs one name per organism.

notes.title: 01 – Why Every Organism Needs One Name

keyPoints: **Local names** change from place to place: one fruit is aam, mango, maamidi, aamba and maavu.
One common name can also mean **different organisms**: the robin of Europe and the robin of America are different species.
About **1.7 to 1.8 million species** have been described.
A **scientific name** is the same worldwide and belongs to only one organism.
Mango is **Mangifera indica** everywhere in the world.
